_about: Clearly fictional IronPulse demo dataset. scripts/seed_demo.py loads it into PostgreSQL through the app's models and services; the app itself never reads this file, so after loading these gyms, accounts and shops exist only as database rows (edit or delete them in the app like any other data). Re-running the loader only adds entries that are missing. Images are generated and labelled DEMO / SPECIMEN.
